system.description:
Starting at 18th level you have learned to utilize your Phantasm to manipulate the perception of reality and invalidate creatures’ ability to differentiate real from fake. Your Phantasms no longer require a Bonus Action to be commanded, instead always acting during your turn. They can exist up to 1 mile away from you, and once dispelled you gain all visual and auditory information the Phantasm experienced.

Phantasm

Illusion

Armor Class 20

Hit Points 10

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | - | +0 | CON | - | +0 | WIS | - | +0 |

| DEX | - | +0 | INT | - | +0 | CHA | - | +0 |

Damage Immunities All, except for Psychic, Force and Necrotic

Condition Immunities All

Senses Uses Summoner Senses

Incorporeal Movement. The phantasm can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Phantasmic Form. This creature is a Visual illusory construct and cannot be detected with Tremor sense, Blindsight or any auditory senses.

Attacks

Ghastly Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: +(Genjutsu Attack Bonus) to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d6 + 4 Psychic damage. On a critical Hit, the target gains +1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken.

Maddening Echo (Recharge 5-6 or Recharge 1 Minute). The Phantasm opens its mouth revealing a twisted hole of incomprehensible darkness, fear and misery. All creatures of your choice in a 15 feet cone originating from the Phantasm that isn’t Blinded must make a Wisdom saving throw. Once the Phantasm uses this ability, it dispels itself. Success: Affected creature is able to resist this maddening effect. Failure: Affected creature suffers flashbacks to memories they never had taking 3d6 psychic damage and gaining 1 rank of Berserk. Critical Failure: Same a failure, but they take 4d6 psychic damage and gain 3 ranks of Berserk.
